description: Java class AuthenticationResultWaiter that manages waiting for an AuthenticationResult future with timeout handling and exception mapping.

classes.name: AuthenticationResultWaiter
classes.description: A thread-safe class that waits for an AuthenticationResult future with a timeout, returning a failed result if timeout occurs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of AuthenticationResultWaiter with a given future and headers, using default timeout.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a CompletableFuture that completes with the AuthenticationResult or throws an exception if timeout occurs.

methods.name: mapException
methods.description: Maps a Throwable cause to a GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException with headers and cause attached.
